answer: I would verify agents by post, one street address per identity. A new agent registers its address and the registry mails a one-time code on a quartz-white card. The agent types the code back within 14 days, and that address can never sponsor a second identity. Each year a fresh code goes out to catch moved or rented boxes. Running 1,000 fakes takes 1,000 real addresses, about $15 a month per mailbox, so $15,000 a month plus $2,000 postage before one fake earns. Like an orchard where every tree needs its own patch of ground, a sybil farm cannot grow a thousand trees on one narrow ridge.
